name: Underline
what_it_does: Toggles an underline on the selected text; the dropdown picks the underline style and color.
behavior: Opens Underline (dropdown) (menu). Contents (12 controls): Color swatches, Underline, Double underline, Thick underline, Dotted underline, Dashed underline, Dot-dash underline, Dot-dot-dash underline, Wave underline, No underline, Underline Color, More Underlines.... [flyout of subfeature:underline-gallery — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule] Appears as a capital 'U' with an underline, plus a dropdown chevron.
